capture.capture_method_note: Synthetic raw_rows representing realistic resolver-observed OTR transitions for the slot; expected_output produced by running the primitive against these rows.  Locks in regression behavior pending replacement by live-DB capture via _capture.py once the resolver is deployed and macro_data.otr_history is populated.

expected_output.methodology_note: Source: macro_data.otr_history (ADR 0003), populated by the on-the-run resolver per ADR 0007. Forward-only ingest: pre-resolver OTR windows are NOT reconstructed — queries that pre-date the resolver's first run return honest absence (transitions=[], current_metrics identity fields None), never a fabricated mapping. Detection-date precision: a window's effective_from is the resolver's first confirmed observation, ~1-2 days after the true auction date at daily incremental cadence (TD #27). Bloomberg has no historical OTR-window screen; this primitive does not recompute what the source of record provides (P12).
